sections.title: LIC Jeevan Umang Plan 745 Overview & IRDAI 2024 Updates

content.text: LIC Jeevan Umang (Table No. 745, UIN: 512N312V03) is LIC's current active participating whole-life plan. Plan 745 superseded legacy Plan 945 (withdrawn October 2024) and Plan 845. Under the latest IRDAI 2024 surrender value guidelines, policies now acquire guaranteed surrender and loan eligibility after just 1 full year of premium payments (reduced from 2 years).

sections.title: How the LIC Jeevan Umang Premium & 8% Survival Income is Calculated

content.text: Our calculator automates the complex actuarial calculations of Plan 745. Here is the exact mathematical step-by-step breakdown of how premiums and survival benefits are determined:

content.heading: 1. Base Tabular Rate & High Sum Assured (HSA) Rebate
content.body: LIC assigns a tabular base premium rate per ₹1,000 of Sum Assured based on your entry age and PPT. For policies with higher sum assured, tabular discounts (HSA rebates) are subtracted: ₹1.25 per ₹1,000 SA for ₹5L+, ₹1.75 per ₹1,000 SA for ₹10L+, and ₹2.00 per ₹1,000 SA for ₹25L+.

content.heading: 2. Modal Rebates & GST Loading (4.5% vs 2.25%)
content.body: A 2% discount is applied for Annual payment mode (1% for Half-Yearly). First-year premiums carry a 4.5% GST load. Renewal premiums for year 2 through PPT carry a reduced 2.25% GST load.

content.heading: 3. Guaranteed 8% Survival Income Formula
content.body: Starting 1 year post-PPT (e.g., at Age 50 for an entry age of 30 with a 20-year PPT), LIC pays an annual survival income calculated as: Survival Benefit = Basic Sum Assured × 8%. For a ₹10 Lakh policy, this equals ₹80,000 per year, 100% tax-free under Section 10(10D), continuing every year until age 99.

content.heading: 4. Age-100 Maturity Wealth Formula
content.body: If the policyholder reaches age 100, the policy matures and pays: Maturity Payout = Basic Sum Assured + Accrued Simple Reversionary Bonuses + Final Additional Bonus (FAB).

content.heading: Case Study 1: The Young Professional (Age 30, ₹10L Cover, PPT 20)
content.body:
Goal: Build a tax-free retirement pension.
Inputs: Age 30, BSA ₹10 Lakh, PPT 20 Years.
Outflow: ~₹39,900/year for 20 years (Total Outflow: ~₹7.8 Lakh).
Result: From Age 50 to 100 (50 years), they receive a guaranteed tax-free income of ₹80,000 every year (Total Survival Cashflow: ₹40 Lakh). At age 100, the nominee receives an estimated maturity lump sum of over ₹25 Lakh.

content.heading: Case Study 2: The Pre-Retiree (Age 45, ₹25L Cover, PPT 15)
content.body:
Goal: Create a supplementary pension floor.
Inputs: Age 45, BSA ₹25 Lakh, PPT 15 Years.
Outflow: ~₹1,65,000/year for 15 years.
Result: From Age 60 to 100, they receive a guaranteed annual pension of ₹2,00,000/year.

content.heading: Case Study 3: Child's Future (Child Age 5, Parent Age 32, PPT 20)
content.body:
Goal: Gift lifelong tax-free passive income to a child.
Inputs: Child Age 5, BSA ₹10 Lakh, PPT 20 Years with PWB Rider.
Result: If the parent passes away during PPT, all future premiums are waived. From the child's 25th birthday, they start receiving ₹80,000 annually for life up to age 100.

content.text: Enhance your policy coverage during the PPT by adding optional riders:

items: Accidental Death & Disability Benefit (AD&DB) Rider: Pays an additional sum equal to the Accident Benefit Sum Assured in case of accidental death or permanent disability.
Term Assurance Rider: Provides additional life cover equal to the Term Rider Sum Assured in case of death during the PPT.

Premium Waiver Benefit (PWB) Rider: Available for policies on minor lives (Age < 18). If the proposer (parent) dies during the PPT, all remaining future premiums are completely waived while policy benefits continue uninterrupted.

sections.title: Surrender Value, Paid-Up Rules & Policy Loans (IRDAI 2024 Updates)

content.text: Under the 2024 IRDAI guidelines, LIC Jeevan Umang Plan 745 offers enhanced liquidity and flexibility:

items: 1-Year Surrender Rule: Policy acquires Guaranteed Surrender Value (GSV) after completing just 1 full policy year.
Policy Loan Facility: Borrow up to 75% of surrender value for active policies (65% for paid-up policies) at ~9% simple annual interest.
Paid-Up Conversion: If you stop paying premiums after 1 year, the policy reduces to a 'Paid-Up' status with proportionate reduced sum assured and reduced survival benefits.

content.text: To calculate exact surrender values or loan amounts, use our LIC Surrender Value Calculator and LIC Paid-Up Value Calculator.

items.q: What is the difference between LIC Plan 945 and Plan 745?
items.a: Plan 745 (UIN: 512N312V03) is the current active version of LIC Jeevan Umang launched under updated IRDAI guidelines. Plan 945 and Plan 845 were legacy plan numbers for the same whole-life product structure.

items.q: How does the Jeevan Umang guaranteed 8% survival income work?
items.a: After your chosen Premium Paying Term (15, 20, 25, or 30 years) ends, LIC pays a guaranteed 8% of your Basic Sum Assured every year until age 99 or death.

items.q: What is the maturity payout at age 100 under Plan 745?
items.a: At age 100, the policyholder receives the Basic Sum Assured + Accumulated Simple Reversionary Bonuses + Final Additional Bonus (FAB).

items.q: Is the 8% annual survival income tax-free?
items.a: Yes! Survival benefit payouts and maturity proceeds from LIC Jeevan Umang are 100% tax-free under Section 10(10D) of the Income Tax Act.

items.q: Can I take a loan on my LIC Jeevan Umang policy?
items.a: Yes, under 2024 IRDAI rules, you can take a policy loan up to 75% of your surrender value after completing just 1 full year of premium payments.
